import collections,csv,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools/recovery')
from canonicalize_helpers import sha,read,span
from inspect_release import Image
from capstone import Cs,CS_ARCH_X86,CS_MODE_32
from capstone.x86_const import X86_OP_IMM,X86_OP_MEM
stage=sys.argv[1];assert stage in ['native','rebuilt']
paths=['.recovery/2022-ManalinkEh.dll','G:/Manalink/ManalinkEh_10_22_Hotfix.dbg'] if stage=='native' else ['ManalinkEh.dll','ManalinkEh.dbg']
im=Image(Path(paths[0]).read_bytes());dbg=Image(Path(paths[1]).read_bytes());symbols=collections.defaultdict(set)
for n,o,s,k,t in dbg.symbols:
 if s>0 and k==32:symbols[n].add(0x2000000+dbg.pe.sections[s-1].VirtualAddress+o)
starts=sorted({a for values in symbols.values() for a in values})
for n in ['_get_card_instance','_lobotomy_effect']:assert len(symbols[n])==1,n
getter=next(iter(symbols['_get_card_instance']));lobotomy=next(iter(symbols['_lobotomy_effect']))
meta=list(csv.DictReader(Path('.recovery/reccmp/current-refresh-c725.metadata.csv').open()));md=Cs(CS_ARCH_X86,CS_MODE_32);md.detail=True
rows=json.loads(Path('.recovery/reccmp/spell-query-plan-c726.json').read_bytes());results=[]
for r in rows:
 if stage=='native':base=int(r['address'],0);size=int(next(m['size'] for m in meta if m['address']==r['address']))
 else:
  assert len(symbols['_'+r['name']])==1;base=next(iter(symbols['_'+r['name']]));size=next(a for a in starts if a>base)-base
 raw=im.pe.get_data(base-0x2000000,size);code=list(md.disasm(raw,base));assert sum(i.size for i in code)==size
 call_indices=[j for j,i in enumerate(code) if i.mnemonic=='call' and i.operands[0].type==X86_OP_IMM and i.operands[0].imm==getter]
 assert len(call_indices)==2,(stage,r['name'],len(call_indices))
 sites=[]
 for j in call_indices:
  part=code[max(0,j-6):min(len(code),j+8)]
  sites.append(dict(call=hex(code[j].address),instructions=[dict(address=hex(i.address),instruction=i.mnemonic+' '+i.op_str) for i in part]))
 if r['name']=='card_lobotomy':
  j=call_indices[-1];next_call=next(i for i in code[j+1:] if i.mnemonic=='call')
  assert next_call.operands[0].type==X86_OP_IMM and next_call.operands[0].imm==lobotomy
  between=[i for i in code[j+1:] if i.address<next_call.address]
  assert any(i.mnemonic=='mov' and len(i.operands)==2 and i.operands[1].type==X86_OP_MEM and i.operands[1].mem.disp==0x74 for i in between),'Final target player is not re-read after getter'
 results.append(dict(name=r['name'],address=hex(base),size=size,sha256=sha(raw),bytes_hex=raw.hex(),getter_sites=sites,scope='Selected direct getter sites and final Lobotomy getter-to-effect path only. Full event reachability/order is reviewed against the native decompilation; this site inventory is not a full CFG proof.'))
name='get_random_card_in_hand';row=next(m for m in meta if m['name']==name)
if stage=='native':base=int(row['address'],0);size=int(row['size'])
else:
 assert len(symbols['_'+name])==1;base=next(iter(symbols['_'+name]));size=next(a for a in starts if a>base)-base
raw=im.pe.get_data(base-0x2000000,size);code=list(md.disasm(raw,base));stores={}
for i in code:
 if i.mnemonic=='mov' and i.operands[0].type==X86_OP_MEM:
  op=i.operands[0]
  if not op.mem.base and not op.mem.index and op.mem.disp in [0x628c10,0x628c0c]:
   assert op.mem.disp not in stores;stores[op.mem.disp]=i
assert set(stores)=={0x628c10,0x628c0c} and stores[0x628c10].address<stores[0x628c0c].address
assert stores[0x628c10].operands[0].size==4 and stores[0x628c0c].operands[0].size==1
a=stores[0x628c10].address;b=stores[0x628c0c].address+stores[0x628c0c].size
network=dict(name=name,address=hex(base),function_size=size,function_sha256=sha(raw),payload_store=hex(a),kind_store=hex(stores[0x628c0c].address),site_bytes_hex=raw[a-base:b-base].hex(),instructions=[dict(address=hex(i.address),instruction=i.mnemonic+' '+i.op_str) for i in code if a<=i.address<b],scope='Payload word is written before packet-kind byte in actual instructions, matching unchanged source. Cached Ghidra statements reverse these independent stores. No network I/O is executed and no whole-function/asynchronous protocol proof is inferred.')
out=dict(stage=stage,inputs={p:sha(Path(p).read_bytes()) for p in paths},script_sha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),getter_address=hex(getter),functions=results,network_store_observation=network)
Path(f'.recovery/reccmp/spell-query-sites-{stage}-c726.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
print(stage,': twelve getter sites, Lobotomy fresh target load and payload-before-kind packet stores verified.')

import json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools/recovery')
from canonicalize_helpers import read,span,mask,sha
packet=json.loads(Path('.recovery/reccmp/semantic-call-leads-c725.json').read_bytes())['functions'];rows=[]
for index in [10,12,20,25,117]:
 r=packet[index];source=r['source'];name=r['name'];s=read(source);before=s[slice(*span(s,name))];assert before==r['body']
 code=mask(before);declaration=re.search(r'(?m)^[ \t]*card_instance_t\s*\*\s*(\w+)\s*=\s*get_card_instance\(player, card\);[ \t]*\n',code)
 assert len(re.findall(r'\bget_card_instance\s*\(',code))==1
 if declaration:
  variable=declaration[1];after=before[:declaration.start()]+before[declaration.end():]
 else:
  assert name=='card_tendrils_of_agony' and not re.search(r'\binstance\b',code)
  variable='instance';assert before.count('get_card_instance(player, card)')==1
  after=before.replace('get_card_instance(player, card)',variable,1)
 point=re.search(r'(?m)^([ \t]*)if \(event == EVENT_RESOLVE_SPELL\)',mask(after));assert point
 prefix=mask(after[:point.start()]);assert prefix.count('{')-prefix.count('}')==1
 assert 'IS_GS_EVENT' in prefix and prefix.rfind('default_target_definition')>prefix.rfind('IS_GS_EVENT')
 after=after[:point.start()]+point[1]+'card_instance_t* '+variable+' = get_card_instance(player, card);\n'+after[point.start():]
 assert span(after,name)==(0,len(after))
 rows.append(dict(name=name,source=source,address=r['address'],before=before,after=after,kind='native_spell_prefix_instance_query',reason='Restore one get_card_instance after target setup on every accepted GS event, before resolution dispatch and target validation. Keep EVENT_QUERY early return and unaffected-cast guards. Native duplicated prefixes perform this query even where its result is unused; the resolution path retains the same saved instance pointer and live target-field reads after callbacks. No card-rule change or whole-function/gameplay equivalence claim.',native=r['native'],native_path=r['native_path']))
r=packet[576];assert r['name']=='card_lobotomy';s=read(r['source']);before=s[slice(*span(s,r['name']))];assert before==r['body']
old='lobotomy_effect(player, target, id, -1, 1);';new='lobotomy_effect(player, get_card_instance(player, card)->targets[0].player, id, -1, 1);'
assert before.count(old)==1;after=before.replace(old,new,1)
rows.append(dict(name=r['name'],source=r['source'],address=r['address'],before=before,after=after,kind='native_post_selection_target_reload',reason='Restore native fresh get_card_instance/target-player read immediately before lobotomy_effect, after hand enumeration, ID/basic-land queries and any show_deck callbacks. Initial hand scan still uses its original saved target; the final effect uses the live target field. Keep validation and choice/fallback logic unchanged. No broad gameplay proof.',native=r['native'],native_path=r['native_path']))
for r in rows:
 assert r['before']!=r['after'];assert span(r['after'],r['name'])==(0,len(r['after']))
 r['before_sha256']=sha(r['before'].encode());r['after_sha256']=sha(r['after'].encode())
Path('.recovery/reccmp/spell-query-plan-c726.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Planned five native spell-prefix queries and Lobotomy post-selection target reload.')
